packageRules.description: linuxserver/tautulli publishes thousands of tags, of which only the bare `<major>.<minor>.<patch>` ones from `2.7.6` on are release tags; the rest are `develop-`/`version-`/`amd64-`/`arm64v8-` flavours and `v<version>-ls<rebuild>` builds. The bare tags also include 20 date-stamped `2021.<month>.<day>` builds from late 2021, which semver would sort above every real release. The regex keeps the major version to at most three digits, so those can never be proposed as an upgrade.
